description: The file defines a PHP class 'Ip' within the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Extension\Opencart\Fraud'. The class provides methods for checking if an IP address associated with an order is flagged as fraudulent, and for retrieving IP data from the database.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: A model class for handling IP-based fraud detection within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks whether the IP address associated with an order or customer is flagged as fraudulent based on stored IPs.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP records from the database matching a given IP address.
